messages:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding request from Acme Labs. They need a multi-cloud org setup (GCP + AWS + Azure) with GPU capacity (initial target: 20 A100-class GPUs across us-west / eu-west), separate billing, strict tags, and KMS for model keys. Can we run through a short checklist before I reply with timelines?

aj: Quick checklist idea: project/account creation, billing link, IAM roles & least privilege, service accounts for infra, quota requests for GPU + networking, VPC/subnet CIDR plan, firewall/NAT rules, KMS/HSM setup, tagging policy, monitoring & budget alerts.

maria: Yep — can you break out which items we need to hit per cloud? Keep it short.

aj: GCP: create org node or use customer-managed org? - Create project(s): acme-infra, acme-prod, acme-dev - Link billing account: beta billing link - Enable APIs: compute.googleapis.com, iam.googleapis.com, servicenetworking.googleapis.com - Quota: request GPUs (A100) via Cloud Console quota page and ask for regional GPUs (us-west1 / europe-west1) - Reserve static external IPs if they need fixed egress - VPC: shared VPC if they want central networking - KMS: create key ring in each region, include HSM requirement if requested

sam: AWS: new account under org (recommended) or sub-account? - Request EC2 GPU quotas (p4d/p4/gaudi as appropriate) via Service Quotas console: https://console.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/home?region=us-east-1#!/services/ec2/quotas - Raise ENI and EBS throughput limits if we plan multi-host clusters - Create IAM role for cross-account deploys (external-id), OIDC provider for IRSA if k8s - S3 bucket policy: block public access, restrict to VPC endpoints - KMS: customer-managed CMK; ask security if they want AWS CloudHSM

olivia: Azure: subscriptions per environment, link to billing scope, request GPU quotas via portal (NVIDIA A100 availability varies by region), create managed identities, enable Private Link for storage if needed.

maria: Networking specifics? We need to avoid overlapping CIDRs with customer on-prem.

ricardo: Suggest /16 per environment, /20 per subnet. Example: 10.10.0.0/16 prod, 10.11.0.0/16 staging, 10.12.0.0/16 dev. Use non-overlap checklist item and ask customer to confirm existing ranges. For cloud interconnect / direct connect: plan BGP prefixes & ASN.

kevin: Cost controls: set up budget alerts tied to tags/cost center immediately after billing link. Put a default quota of spend alerts at 25%/50%/75%/90% so finance can sign off. Also request committed reservation guidance for GPUs — reserved capacity can reduce unit cost but needs 6–12 month commit.

maria: Good. For quotas: who will actually submit the increase requests per cloud? Need names + expected lead times.

aj: I'll file GCP quota requests (lead time 24–72h usually, but A100 regional availability can take longer). Will include expected VM family and accelerators. I'll paste sample gcloud snippet for enabling APIs and linking billing:

```
# create project
gcloud projects create acme-prod --name="acme-prod" --organization=ORGANIZATION_ID
# link billing
gcloud beta billing projects link acme-prod --billing-account=BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID
# enable compute API
gcloud services enable compute.googleapis.com iam.googleapis.com
```

aj: And sample quota ask body (for internal tracking): GPU type: NVIDIA A100 40GB, region: us-west1, quota: 10 -> justification: ML inference + training for prod cluster.

sam: I'll open AWS Service Quotas requests and create the cross-account IAM role template. Sample IAM role trust policy we use for deploys: 

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:root"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"sts:ExternalId": "ACME_EXTERNAL_ID"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

olivia: I'll handle Azure quota requests and subscription/billing setup. Heads-up: Azure sometimes requires a support request for capacity — expect 3–7 business days if SKU is constrained.

maria: Security asks: KMS keys should have key rotation enabled and restricted IAM. Also need audit log retention policy. Can security confirm retention length?

kevin: Security: we default to 1 year retention for audit logs, escalate if compliance needs longer. KMS access limited to roles: infra-admin, kms-operator, security-audit.

ricardo: For networking: enable Private Google Access on subnets, Cloud NAT if there's no external IPs, and VPC flow logs for traffic auditing. For AWS use Transit Gateway for multi-AZ VPC connectivity if they want central egress.

maria: Anything about tagging? Customer insists on strict tags: team, cost_center, project, environment, provisioner.

olivia: We'll push a tag policy (Azure Policy / GCP Org Policy / AWS Tagging policies) and enforce on resource creation. Add a check in provisioning pipeline that fails if tags missing.

aj: Action items recap: 1) aj -> submit GCP quota requests (A100 x20 split across regions) + enable APIs (ETA 48h) 2) sam -> create AWS quota requests + role templates + S3/KMS policy (ETA 48-72h) 3) olivia -> create Azure subscriptions & quota ticket (ETA 3-7 days) 4) ricardo -> VPC CIDR plan + BGP plan + firewall rules (ETA 24h) 5) kevin -> billing link, budgets, and cost-center tags (ETA 24h) 6) maria -> coordinate customer confirmations and final sign-off (ETA contingent)

maria: Perfect. Please put the quota request links and ticket numbers in this thread once submitted. Also include any region capacity warnings so procurement can offer alternatives (e.g., different GPU family or reserved instances).

aj: Will do. FYI: if A100 capacity is constrained we may propose A10/RTX6000 for inference or sharded smaller instances for training while we wait.

sam: I'll post AWS ticket IDs here when opened.

infra-bot: Reminder: please attach CI/CD runbook and Terraform module versions for account bootstrap per our audit requirements.

maria: Thanks — marking this as the canonical thread for Acme Labs onboarding. I'll follow up with the customer by EOD after we have ticket IDs. :thumbsup:

aj: Added first GCP quota request ticket: GCP-TICKET-98765 (A100 us-west1 x10, europe-west1 x10). ETA 36h.

sam: AWS quota case: AWS-SQ-44321 opened for p4d and ENI increases.

olivia: Azure support case: AZ-87654 for A100 quota in West Europe.

kevin: I created budget alerts and attached cost center tags to the billing account. Will push tag enforcement policy into Terraform next.

maria: Thanks team — keep updates here.
